info.name: Connect Jobs API
info.description: All included utility endpoints for Basiq partners

request.description:
Retrieves the details of all existing and previous jobs associated with a user.

**Note:** This endpoint only returns jobs that are less than 7 days old.

response.name: Returns a list of jobs with details.
